resources.string: Everything about your phone, and the tools to tune it, in one private app.
Osyster cannot send anything anywhere; it never asks for the internet permission.
No accounts, ads, analytics, or crash reports.
Serial numbers, IMEI, phone numbers, and MAC addresses are never read.
A few tools need extra access. Allow what you want now; each tool also asks when you open it.
The Stay awake countdown and its Stop button
Location and phone access are asked only on the Network page, when you choose to see those details.

string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: Barcode scanner: Read QR codes and barcodes with the camera, from a picture, or from the share sheet, with a history on the phone.
Bluetooth remote: Control a TV, computer, or tablet as a remote, touchpad, air mouse, keyboard, or gamepad.
Music widgets: A grid and a tiles widget with square art and buttons you can arrange.
Data widgets: Pick the period and what to show, and a compact 2x1 size.
Private DNS: A widget to turn Private DNS on and off.
